opportunities.title: What buyers forget to budget for
opportunities.premise: Wren names the costs Wren's own recent buyers did not see coming, when each showed up, and the one question Wren has every buyer ask their lender.

opportunities.title: The line in an inspection report buyers skim past
opportunities.premise: Wren tells one anonymized story where an inspection report pointed to a specialist, and what Wren tells buyers to do the day a report arrives.

opportunities.title: When an offer loses on terms, not price
opportunities.premise: Wren uses one offer Wren's buyers won or lost on terms to explain which terms Wren talks through before writing any offer.
